identity.title: [v0.92.2][planning] Audit and refresh first-pass milestone documentation

values.goal: Produce a coherent, reviewed, number-free first-pass v0.92.2 planning package and explicitly disposition relevant unplanned or unscheduled TBD material.
values.required_outcome: The canonical planning package, feature set, issue wave, execution specifications, sprint structure, release tail, and TBD scheduling reconciliation agree without opening the milestone or creating implementation issues.
authority_boundary: #620 prepares documentation but does not open v0.92.2
The existing v0.92.2 package is the baseline to audit rather than recreate
Unresolved scheduling gaps require operator judgment and are not silently scheduled
Existing GitHub issue and completion truth prevents duplicate planning
operator_constraints: Do not create WP-01, sprint umbrellas, or child implementation issues
Do not create the milestone or version label
Do not implement product, Runtime, provider, cloud, or Unity features
Do not edit or delete TBD sources merely to clean the inventory
Do not broaden v0.92.2 with explicitly deferred work
